reviews.title: Check in staff require customer service skills training
reviews.text: The 2 ladies checking in customers on the 8.20am flight to Budapest at john lennon airport on the 15th January 2024 have to be the rudest staff I have experienced whilst travelling.
reviews.author: chris d

reviews.title: OK if travelling light, but otherwise ....
reviews.text: We travel with them three or four times a year as we have no choice if we wish to fly from our local airport. To be fair, we haven't had the troubles many on here have, but have had flights cancelled and that's a nightmare with Wizz. We normally travel light and keep things as simple as possible, so things mostly go without a hitch. When things do go wrong though, you'll get no help and no answers. Baggage costs are daylight robbery and services of any sort are expensive and poor. They are what they are ... If you pretend it's a third world bus and a cheap way to get from A to B with no baggage, then it's fine. If you expect anything more from this company, you'll be disappointed.
reviews.author: Ivan M

reviews.title: Worked for me!
reviews.text: Wizz Air’s flight suited me. As had luggage booked premium fare and had none of the issues you can cop with add ons, fees etc with low cost carriers. Sure it’s cramped but for a 2 hour flight it was fine. The bottle of red wine I purchased much better than other low cost carriers. My trip went like clockwork.
reviews.author: D C

reviews.title: Don’t book if there is any chance you may want to cancel or that your flight may be cancelled due to conflict
reviews.text: This has got to be the worst company for aftersales service can’t get my refund can’t speak to a real person unless I pay £1.45 per minute while the operator hums and hars and mumbles away while I’m racking up charges. They cancelled my outbound flight but won’t reimburse me for my return flight never heard such nonsense in my life and how do I get my money back well who knows Wizzair is worse than the scammers because they pretend to be legit, I’m absolutely furious don’t know where to go to get satisfaction
reviews.author: Jerome M

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: I was just asked to pay £48 to take bag on board but I already paid for it. Women at the gate refused to board me unless that I pay. My booking said free carry on bag and 10 kg bag, she said that I can’t take my bag and need to put in baggage but baggage is no longer accepted. Wizz air system is extremely confusing, I’m very dissatisfied in the app, process of ticket booking change as it’s not clear how can I add carry on bag later on, there was no clarification about that in the airport and gate was open 50 mins before flight, so there was no way for me to learn from anyone that misleading information on the ticket is not correct. And for the customer service from that clerk at gate - it’s not like I didn’t pay for that bag but I clearly explained to her that as per what is written on my ticket I understood that bag can be taken with me. She show no interest, gave me no receipt except card slip and didn’t offer any solution to get this bag in baggage
reviews.author: Albina Z

reviews.title: Bandits. Terrible, totally unreliable company.
reviews.text: Totally, totally unreliable. Stopped using them around since 2022 due to unrealibility. After a long time risked to buy a flight with them again - got cancelled 4h before flight at 2:00 AM when I just started to drive to airport. No obvious weather reasons - surely "commercial reasons". I lost my money paid for airport parking. Reoccuring issue . ALWAYS problems - either massive delays or late cancellations. NEVER EVER WIZZAir again!!!
reviews.author: Inga M

reviews.title: Superb and possitively surprised
reviews.text: Great experience, clean and fresh aircraft with a super friendly and helpful crew. First time flying Wizzair and was expecting something different from what I'd heard about them, but was positively surprised and would happily fly with them again, even on longer flights of +5 hours.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: You get what you pay for…
reviews.text: Cheap airline, delays or cancellations galore, non existent customer service et good luck getting any compensation of any kind…
reviews.author: Luc H

reviews.title: Flights fine, app not.
reviews.text: Firstly, the actual flights were fine. Return better as perfectly on time. Outbound was odd as not told a delay but there was one of nearly an hour. Staff were pleasant. The app however, a different story. Both me and husband had it, but my husband could see and access more information than I could , even though I was lead passenger, I made the initial booking. We paid for Priority, no problem there. Check in for outbound was fine. Check in for return was non existent! Got all the way to the end, app then said Booking not found! Paid for auto booking, didn't work. The stress was awful, fearing we would be charged at the airport which is what we had read, Got to Heraklion airport, (utter shambles though not airlines fault), once we eventually got to the correct desk, it was easy! I'd use again if I had no other option, but won't be first choice.
reviews.author: Trish S

reviews.title: Worst Airline Experience
reviews.text: I travelled from Athens to London and back again with WizzAir. It was my first experience with the airline and will definitely be my last. My first flight (from Athens to London) was rescheduled four (!) times with a very short notice. Later I was told by other customers that this is the norm with WizzAir. The worst part was my return flight to Athens. Not only the flight was delayed and rescheduled two times, but till the very last minute the flight was not even mentioned on the departures board. Once we got to the gate of our already delayed flight (00:40 instead of 22:05), the airlines’ stuff was measuring each and every passenger’s bag and made at least have of them pay mostly for a size difference of 2-3cm. That caused a huge extra delay and frustration to the exhausted passengers. If that wasn’t enough, at some point the stuff told us that our flight would be postponed for an hour more (!) and we’d have to go back and wait again for another gate to be announced. Finally, when we went to the second gate, there were extra delays as there was only one employee to check all the passengers’ passports. When we got on the plane we had to wait for almost half an hour for them to load the baggages. We arrived in Athens at 6:35 instead of 3:55, just on time for them to not have to pay us the legal refund of a 3 hour delay. No wonder why they are called everywhere online the “worst european airline”. A hell of an experience!👏
reviews.author: smarpap

reviews.title: Unpleasant experience
reviews.text: The company itself doing inappropriate actions as they are taking extra money for hand bags. We Mets weight and high restrictions, but the argument was “we have total booked placed for laguage tho this is extra”. Why I have to pay more if you guys are not able to plan your capacity. And no one explained it to me in English. Only local language. But my local is not so good to understand, and the crew did not switched to English when I asked. It is total disappointment for me.
reviews.author: Nonna D

reviews.title: Good flight but bad experience at airport dropoff
reviews.text: I always love flying with Wizz. However, Rome FCO drop off (check in desks) are vary bad organized, unable to face many passengers. Having our flight at 7:10 we arrived at the airport at 4:30. We merged the line (priority) after one hour we were still in the line while they called “urgent passengers” to go first. We were still in the line when they called even for passengers scheduled 10 minutes before us. This means we were not in a hurry , but we became “urgent” after staying 1 hour and 20 in the line . So , Wizz staff at the registers were able to make “urgent” even people who had come three hours before. That is a shame. A better organization of that service is required . If they are not able to do so , they had better sell less flights .
reviews.author: Rosario

reviews.title: unreliable, delays upon delays
reviews.text: More and more unreliable. Piority means no priority at all. Lame excuses for unprofessionalism and bad services. Lots of delays.
reviews.author: Marius C

reviews.title: Shambles
reviews.text: What a dreadful experience. Outgoing flight was 45 mins late leaving (yes we were all seated on the aircraft). But the return journey was beyond awful. The bag drop was so stressful. Not enough ground staff for 4 flights checking in/bag drop. Result was complete chaos. We queued for 2 hours just for bag drop. Then the plane was delayed - take off was meant to be 21:40 but took off 23:00.
reviews.author: Singh F

reviews.title: Absolutely terrible experience from Wizz Air
reviews.text: When we attempted to check in 24 hours prior to our original flight time, the Whizz Air app wouldn’t let us due to a technical issue, forcing us to check-in manually at the airport desk with our luggage to be checked-in. As this was an issue with the app, we absolutely shouldn’t have been charged as per the app states: “Our apologies! We are not able to issue you a boarding card at the moment. Please proceed to our check-in desk 2 hours before your flight’s departure, so a check in agent can assist you free of charge”, however, we were charged £87 JUST to check in for our flight. We were then told that we wouldn’t be guaranteed a place on our flight as it was overbooked, despite us having 2 valid travel tickets paid for AND being given 2 valid boarding passes at the airport. After several delays to our flight, it was eventually cancelled completely with no reason given. This has forced us to pay a ridiculous amount of money for an alternative flight. This service has been completely unacceptable and unprofessional and we are incredibly disappointed with Wizz Air and definitely will not be travelling with them again. Their level of customer service during this stressful event has been dismal, being hung up on the phone, live chat agents leaving the chat multiple times and not even a reason for the flight being cancelled. Save your hassle and search literally any other airline first.
reviews.author: Joe G

reviews.title: booking of baggage with Wizzair turn out 3 time the price
reviews.text: book additional services like adding a suitcase. In my example it the final payment was 3 times more expensive than the price you accepted on two screens before. Finally the suitcase is more expensive than the flight itself. isn't it cheating? Yes after accepting the price in two screens already, i was stupid enough to click on the button "pay 306BGN"
reviews.author: Martin N

reviews.title: Horrendous bunch of scam artists
reviews.text: We tried without success to book-in online for this flight, firstly it said unless we paid 16 per seat we had to wait until 24 hours before departure, then as soon as 24 hours was reached the login failed (wrong password even though it was the one previously used) and when we clicked on missing password it said e-mail sent but none ever arrived, even though other Wizz emails did. On arriving at the airport we were delayed so when we finally were allowed to check-in we were told we were to late for free check in (since when do you pay for check in?) and were blackmailed into paying 60 euros per person plus a "handling fee" or we would not be allowed to fly. We were not alone this scam was applied to at least another 10 customers and probably many more - bunch of thieving crooks, DO NOT USE.
reviews.author: Roy J

reviews.title: Beware of online check in and excess charges
reviews.text: Beware that if you book with Wiz Air there is a chance it will mention that “you are unable to check in, wait a few hours and try again or arrive 3 hours prior to fight” don’t trust it as once you get there they will send you to their office and charge you for it. Customer service as well was rude on arrival. Paid for baggage and have a receipt? No you didn’t, pay again or don’t fly as it sounds. I’d rather walk to my destination than Fly Wiz again. Or just go Ryan Air as another budget flight company at least you get an online boarding pass 😊
reviews.author: Michael T

reviews.title: The worst airline ever
reviews.text: They cancelled mu flights 25 minutes after the departure time. Did not offer a refund and left me stranded at the airport with no alternative. I had a non refundable hotel that I lost the money for, and they didn't even give me the flight money back. Their lame excuse was that the flight was cancelled due to bad weather, but it was a sunny day with 30 degrees outside. Their customer service representatives are rude and self entitled and very very unprofessional. The worst airline ever, i hope they will go bankrupt soon as they deserve. Even Ryanair is so much better to a higher standard.
reviews.author: Enkela

reviews.title: Terrible experience with wizz air service
reviews.text: Terrible service at Prague airport-40 euros for check-in at the airport,for 5 member family 200 euros extra.Than at the gate charging another 50 pounds for the carry on baggage,that was the exact cm as it should be.There were a lot of people charged-everyone mad,screaming,chaos,kins crying.Perfect beggining of your vacation. The best is-on our way back,nobody cared about our baggage,there were people with bigger baggage. The flight itself was ok.
reviews.author: Jitka K

reviews.title: Do not use this airline
reviews.text: Appalling treatment, flight was 4 hours delayed and they gave us no information or facilities for the wait. The hostesses refused to provide any information as to why and we’re often incredibly rude and dismissive of anyone who’s accent was different. I’m shocked they are allowed to run, constantly delayed, baggage allowance makes your ticket hundreds of pounds more expensive and my friend who is average height still had to splay his legs just to sit down. Would recommend not buying anything through this airline. Not worth a penny.
reviews.author: emily v

reviews.title: Incredible rubbish dog💩 (no profanity allowed)
reviews.text: Never fly on this, over 2 flight we had a 4 hour delay. Forced to sit on plane and wait for the whole period with no option to get off. A man in his 60s was extremely unhappy and was still not allowed to leave the aircraft. The food is bad (no profanity allowed). Very little options and awful taste. Honesty I may as well just taken a dump on some bread and eaten it. The seat space is the worst I have ever experienced. The staff are nice but not particularly helpful. Think that sums it all up. Basically never choose this rubbish airline or you will regret it.
reviews.author: Sam L

reviews.title: I couldn’t take my wheelchair with me
reviews.text: When I called Wizzair to register my electric wheelchair, they said that the battery is not safe for flying. I have flown using Norwegian airlines with the wheelchair before without any problem. I even sent Wizzair an email with a document certifying that the battery is safe for flying, but they said it’s their policy and they cannot allow my wheelchair on board. Even when I am flying with other wheelchairs there is always a problem at check in, and the Wizzair staff is always rude!!! And the seats are really uncomfortable. Everything with Wizzair is TERRIBLE!!!
reviews.author: Filip K

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: Wizz air was consistently terrible from start to finish I'll list a few issues 1. Trouble checking in as app kept crashing. 2. Changed flying times several times. 3. Long delays even though the flight time had move to later so lost day of holiday. 4. Even though we paid for seats together when boarding plane we got handed a scrap of paper giving new seats, we all got split up but unable to claim seat reservation money back. 5. Everything was rushed at boarding to the point of being chaos. 6. Trying to contact wizz is near on, you get into the chat room and then the continuous going around in circles start ALL I CAN SAY IS SAVE YOUR MONEY AND FLY WITH SOMEONE ELSE AS WIZZ ARE THE WORST AIRLINE I HAVE COME ACROSS. ( This is from a man who has flown all around the world over the years)
reviews.author: Andrew W

reviews.title: Soul destroying - do not book wizz, you will regret
reviews.text: After I booked and paid for my fight I came to check the reviews, as I’ve never heard of this airline before. Immediately I was nervous and anxious after reading the reviews (especially as I’m a solo female traveler) I decided to spend £18 to book a pay for a seat before hand for my peace of mind after reading how I may need to queue then pay £45 to check at the airport. My flight was delayed both on departure and arrival by an hour (I wasn’t shocked or disappointed, as I was expecting this by now) they did send an email 2 hours in advance informing about the delay but no explanation so I took a book with me and my earpods for music, I sat in weather spoons and had a couple of GnT”s while waiting. When boarding nobody checked the size or weight of my backpack, they didn’t even acknowledge it. The pilot apologised through the tannoy of the delay and blamed air traffic controllers!! Same excuse on the way back. The cabin crew looked tired and bored and were just about cracking a smile as people boarded. The plane was tiny, cramped, dirty and the seats were very uncomfortable, it was also freezing with air conditioning blowing like crazy for 4,5 hours straight. In the way back it was worse cabin crew was miserable and the male steward was just flapping he’s arms around and yawning showing where the emergency doors are!! I tried to sleep but it was impossible, one cabin crew constantly strutted up and down the isle in her high heels stamping her feet and walking full speed, as th
reviews.author: Amber Palmer

reviews.title: Never ever use wizz air!
reviews.text: We flew with Wizz Air for the first time and it will be our last! . Please please do not use this company, they have no schedule, no time lines , no customer care whatsoever, from what I saw with my own eyes I could not believe how you could leave a entire flight full of people with no water , food or any hotel accommodation in limbo as there had to be a diversion from a medical emergency. The diversion is unfortunate but totally understandable.The problem was the lack of care shown by wizz Air and the fact they had no management in place to sort out visa status for all the passengers in order for us to enter customs to Italy as this is where the flight had been diverted to. No thought for how mums , children, and babies would cope without any water, baby milk or food . I feel sorry for the flight attendants as you had to lie over and over again , that’s something they had to do but it will stay with you for the rest of your life. At one stage there was talk of walking out onto the runway, every single passenger, children and babies to get some kind of help and attention from Wizz Air , that’s how bad it had got, innocent people would have been willing to get arrested just to get help! To end , just take the time to read so many reviews of how bad this air line is and I don’t know how it’s still being allowed to operate in this manner.
reviews.author: Idealsam29

reviews.title: LOW -COST !!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Wizzair not low - cost London to Sofia Wizzair 519 20kg, British 245 23 kg luggage. Easy jet 264 23 kg luggage. Plus I had a bad experience with Wizzair always late cancelation. I HAVE USED IT A LOT NOT ANYMORE. WIZZAIR LOGO IS NEVER ON TIME. NOT CHEAP.
reviews.author: Yordan

reviews.title: Stranded at the airport with no information!
reviews.text: The airline cancelled our flight yesterday after more than 5h of delay. The captain gave a small speech and then said he would not take any question for us and would leave us to the airport personnel, who had to work over-hours to accomodate us all. We then waited until midnight to be checked in in an hotel with the promise that our flight would leave the next morning at 9am. At 6am we then discover that the flight has been again delayed to 10.30am. There is no personnel at the airport to guide us and we have no information aside from the emails that inform us of additional delays. I tried to call the call centers both in France and Italy: they have been closed all over the weekend (wonder if they exist at all). It's more than 200 people here, with children and old people waiting and receiving no water, no food, no information against all European legislation. I warmly suggest to avoid this company. Please do not reserve with Wizz Air!!!
reviews.author: Marco L

reviews.title: Worst ever airline
reviews.text: I had a flight from Abu Dhabi to Napili after 2 hours delay we reached to napoli and now we have no luggage! Imagine one whole flight with no luggage and it is 1 am now and with 2 persons only working in lost and found all passengers need to log their details which probably will take till morning, i lost my night and also my day after as i was planning to stay only one night in Napoli with this awful airline Terrible is too much for them
reviews.author: Mal

reviews.title: Overbooked Flight
reviews.text: The airline has made a habit of overbooking flights. I do not recommend this airline in any case! You will be happy that you saved 100 euros and in the end you will end up paying 500 euros for another flight after being abandoned by Wizzair through an airport at the end of your trip.
reviews.author: Alex
